nodes.name: Normalize and Validate No Response Scan

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($2::INTEGER, 1),
            720
        ) AS lookback_hours,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($3::INTEGER, 1),
            720
        ) AS future_window_hours,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($4::INTEGER, 1),
            500
        ) AS result_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        request.lookback_hours,
        request.future_window_hours,
        request.result_limit

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY clinic.id
    LIMIT 1
),

expired_now AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM appointments appointment,
         clinic_context clinic

    WHERE confirmation.appointment_id =
          appointment.id

      AND appointment.clinic_id =
          clinic.clinic_id

      AND confirmation.status = 'pending'
      AND confirmation.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING
        confirmation.id AS confirmation_request_id
),

expiry_barrier AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expired_count
    FROM expired_now
),

candidate_requests AS (
    SELECT
        confirmation.id AS confirmation_request_id,
        confirmation.appointment_id,
        confirmation.confirmation_token,
        confirmation.channel,
        confirmation.expires_at,

        appointment.patient_id,
        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,
        appointment.status AS appointment_status,

        clinic.clinic_id,
        clinic.clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name,

        EXTRACT(
            EPOCH FROM (
                appointment.starts_at - NOW()
            )
        ) / 3600.0 AS hours_until_appointment

    FROM appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    CROSS JOIN expiry_barrier barrier

    INNER JOIN appointments appointment
        ON appointment.id =
           confirmation.appointment_id

    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON clinic.clinic_id =
           appointment.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id =
           appointment.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id =
           appointment.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id =
           appointment.service_id

    WHERE confirmation.status = 'expired'

      AND confirmation.expires_at >=
            NOW()
            - MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => clinic.lookback_hours
            )

      AND appointment.status IN (
          'pending',
          'confirmed'
      )

      AND appointment.starts_at > NOW()

      AND appointment.starts_at <=
            NOW()
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => clinic.future_window_hours
            )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM human_handoff_tasks existing_task

          WHERE existing_task.source_type =
                'appointment_confirmation'

            AND existing_task.source_record_id =
                confirmation.id

            AND existing_task.task_type =
                'confirmation_no_response'
      )

    ORDER BY
        appointment.starts_at ASC,
        confirmation.id ASC

    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM clinic_context
    )
),

inserted_tasks AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,

        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,

        priority,
        status,

        reason,
        due_at
    )

    SELECT
        candidate.clinic_id,
        candidate.patient_id,
        candidate.appointment_id,

        'confirmation_no_response',
        'appointment_confirmation',
        candidate.confirmation_request_id,

        CASE
            WHEN candidate.hours_until_appointment <= 3
                THEN 'urgent'

            WHEN candidate.hours_until_appointment <= 12
                THEN 'high'

            WHEN candidate.hours_until_appointment <= 24
                THEN 'normal'

            ELSE 'low'
        END,

        'open',

        'بیمار تا پایان مهلت تعیین‌شده به درخواست تأیید نوبت پاسخ نداده است.',

        GREATEST(
            NOW(),

            LEAST(
                candidate.starts_at - INTERVAL '2 hours',
                NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
            )
        )

    FROM candidate_requests candidate

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS handoff_task_id,
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        source_record_id,
        priority,
        status,
        reason,
        due_at,
        created_at
),

task_details AS (
    SELECT
        task.handoff_task_id,
        task.priority,
        task.status AS task_status,
        task.reason,
        task.due_at,
        task.created_at,

        candidate.confirmation_request_id,
        candidate.appointment_id,
        candidate.patient_name,
        candidate.mobile,
        candidate.doctor_name,
        candidate.service_name,
        candidate.timezone,
        candidate.starts_at,
        candidate.ends_at,
        candidate.appointment_status,
        candidate.channel,
        candidate.expires_at

    FROM inserted_tasks task

    INNER JOIN candidate_requests candidate
        ON candidate.confirmation_request_id =
           task.source_record_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM task_details
        )
            THEN 'no_handoffs_needed'

        ELSE 'confirmation_handoffs_created'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM task_details
        )
            THEN 'در حال حاضر درخواست تأیید منقضی‌شده‌ای برای ارجاع به منشی وجود ندارد.'

        ELSE 'موارد بدون پاسخ در صف پیگیری منشی انسانی ثبت شدند.'
    END AS message,

    request.clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM task_details
    ) AS handoff_task_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'handoff_task_id',
                        handoff_task_id,

                    'confirmation_request_id',
                        confirmation_request_id,

                    'appointment_id',
                        appointment_id,

                    'patient_name',
                        patient_name,

                    'mobile',
                        mobile,

                    'doctor_name',
                        doctor_name,

                    'service_name',
                        service_name,

                    'appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),

                    'start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            ends_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'appointment_status',
                        appointment_status,

                    'confirmation_channel',
                        channel,

                    'confirmation_expired_at',
                        expires_at,

                    'priority',
                        priority,

                    'task_status',
                        task_status,

                    'due_at',
                        due_at,

                    'reason',
                        reason,

                    'next_action',
                        'contact_patient_manually'
                )
                ORDER BY starts_at
            )
            FROM task_details
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS handoff_tasks

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## ارجاع عدم پاسخ به منشی انسانی

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 29 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. Workflow دارای سه ورودی است: تست دستی، Webhook و اجرای ساعتی.

3. فقط درخواست‌های تأیید منقضی‌شده برای نوبت‌های فعال آینده وارد صف انسانی می‌شوند.

4. اولویت براساس فاصله تا زمان نوبت تعیین می‌شود.

5. برای یک درخواست تأیید، تسک تکراری ساخته نمی‌شود.
